Hi Samir — looping in the benchmarking info Vanessa promised. Quick note and a few illustrative unit-costs we typically see (these are example comparisons for similar workloads; final pricing will be tailored to your volume commitments and SLA needs):

Benchmark (example $ per 1M tokens) — typical production numbers we share with customers:
- Redwood (hosted, optimized open-model variants + batching/caching): $12 - $25 per 1M tokens depending on quantization and caching profiles; at scale (200-400M) we typically recommend a $10-15 per 1M target with a reserved capacity commit.
- Anthropic / hosted open-model hosts: $25 - $60 per 1M tokens for comparable open-models on managed infra (ranges depend on model family and throughput requirements).
- OpenAI (high-capacity proprietary models): $60 - $200+ per 1M tokens for higher-capability endpoints (smaller models or older families can be cheaper; this range is for high-quality chat/completion endpoints).

Notes: these numbers are illustrative - Redwood's advantage is the ability to run optimized open checkpoints and measure unit economics (batching, KV cache reuse) across real traffic, which often brings effective cost down vs naive host pricing. For a 100-200M token profile, our common proposal would aim for $12-20/1M with a 6-12 month reserved commitment; that should comfortably meet your target of <= $50/1M and keep monthly spend within ~ $12k- $40k depending on exact volumes.

I've attached a short benchmarking CSV and a pricing deck for your procurement review. The deck includes pilot terms (30-day pilot options, success metrics, rollback/fallback policies).

Happy to hop on a quick call with procurement to walk through license terms.

Best — Marissa
